Build an imaginary signal box

Test document: this is not an electrical construction guide.

The term SB means signal box here.

Vocabulary

Signal

A fictional state change.

Indicator

A square drawn on paper.

Procedure

  1. Draw two squares.

    • Label one ready.

    • Label one waiting.

  2. Record a transition using state = ready.

fn next(ready: bool) -> bool {
    !ready
}
